issue: Direct local rate acquisition enables finite completion but does not remove hidden-mobility coverage
clarification: N795 acquires selected microscopic conductances in an explicitly represented finite network and certifies the aggregate effect of unqueried rates within supplied global bounds. The interface differs from N793's identical-static-data hidden-rate lower bound, which remains valid. The stronger37-query structural comparator wins within its promise; the robust full-box method can detect an off-class shortcut but retains exponential state/move coverage and measured-oracle obligations. Finite-precision gains and adaptive/rank-two counterexamples are separately proved. No atomistic gate-discovery or matched operational advantage is established.

issue: Survival-conditioned molecular fringes require explicit erasure and support accounting
clarification: N796's shared-dilation analysis gives the exact discarded-overlap radius sqrt(q_A q_B) and shows that counting all erasures as failures conservatively dominates the full-branch null probability. This is a conditional interface extension to N791 only with its original intended-echo residual, local full-support/reset-or-twirl, coherent control and uniformly calibrated model/apparatus-error assumptions. A survivor-conditioned fringe or branch survival counts alone do not certify operator norm or all-temperature free-energy comparison. Historical N791 theorem remains intact; no hardware calibration has been acquired.
